name: @aion/career-evidence
description: Deterministic local career evidence catalogue and evidence-backed profile

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @aion/career-input && npm run build --workspace @aion/object && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aion/career-input && npm run build --workspace @aion/object && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js" "test/**/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js"
scripts.test:catalogue: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/catalogue.test.js"
scripts.test:facts: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/facts.test.js"
scripts.test:profile: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/profile.test.js"
scripts.test:operations: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/operations.test.js"
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/persistence.test.js"
